about_the_game:
Welcome to Synthopolis, a strange, virtual city from a parallel world, possessing a unique and coveted resource: Color.

In this stylized pursuit FPS, you play as either a Hunter or a Color Bearer in competitive 1v1 rounds lasting 6 minutes. Your goal? Keep the Color until the end to win the round… or relentlessly chase down your opponent to reclaim it.

Slide, leap, and propel yourself using a grappling hook; explore the rooftops and alleys of a brutalist city painted in watercolor, where each trace of Color on the ground can give away your position.

Use temporal items to shorten or extend the countdown and turn the tide of battle. Reflexes, strategy, and anticipation will be your best allies.

🌐 Solo mode: Practice freely or challenge yourself with speedruns.
🔥 Multiplayer mode: Compete in intense matches where roles alternate every round.

🧪 Get an exclusive first look during Steam Next Fest, featuring:

  • Competitive 1v1 multiplayer (Hunter vs. Color Bearer)

  • 1 playable map: the virtual city of Synthopolis

  • Dynamic movement & grappling hook mechanics

  • Time-altering items to manipulate the timer

  • Solo training and exploration mode

  • Stylized 3D aesthetic with grayscale watercolor visuals, immersive atmosphere

Will you keep the Color… or reclaim it?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 6770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX

short_description: Face off and claim the Color at all costs — the life-saving resource of humanity hidden in the mysterious city of Synthopolis. Outplay your opponent in this competitive and visually groundbreaking game.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian
